One factor that could help Democrats is general pessimism among the Michigan electorate about the state of the country. Only one-third of voters believe the U.S. is heading in the right direction, while more voters disapprove of President Donald Trump’s job performance than approve, even among older voters. When the polling team asked Michigan voters in 2024 how they felt about Trump’s first term, his net approval rating was positive by two points.
